_about: One entry per competition feed. Read by scripts/check_feed_health.py (runs in refresh.yml and opens a GitHub issue when a feed looks wrong) and scripts/publish_feed_update.sh (only paths listed in publish_paths may be auto-pushed). Update season dates when a new season is announced. Dates are inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Homepage badges come from here too (scripts/build_feed_status.py -> feed_status.json): 'kind' is 'league' (after the season: 'Off-season') or 'tournament' ('Tournament complete'); optional 'highlights' are time-boxed badge texts [{from, until, text, style: live|offseason}] that win over the computed status.
